text: Tobias Reyne was a solid help on our monthly statement PDF generator project. He built a queue that renders owner statements overnight and stores them in S3, which took us from daily request timeouts to none. The setup now handles about 12k statements a month without us needing to build them on request. Straightforward to work with and delivered what we needed.
